question: A major swimming championship usually brings a handful of world records. How many fell at Rome in 2009?
answer: About 40: 43 world records fell in eight days of racing. Rome was the last world championships before polyurethane bodysuits were banned in January 2010. The Beijing Olympics a year earlier, already called a record glut, had produced 25. Some Rome marks stood for over a decade, set in suits nobody may now wear.
move: When the rules of a game change, old baselines stop applying.
trap: Scaling up from ordinary meets, a record-rich one sounds like ten.
